title: RunPlan
description: The tasks a run would run, in what order, and whether each step would hit the cache, as printed by `vp run --dry-run --json`.

$schema.description: `file://` URL of the JSON Schema that describes this document, written as in `vp run --json`.

version.description: Format version. It changes only for a breaking change: a rename, a removal, or a changed meaning. New fields and values don't change it; ignore fields you don't know.

workspaceRoot.description: Absolute path of the workspace root. Other paths are relative to it, with `/` on every platform, except paths outside the workspace, which are absolute.

plan.description: The tasks this run would run, keyed by task ID. The IDs are the same as in `vp run --json`, which has each task's package name and dependencies.

PlanTask.description: A task the run would run.

package.description: The path of the task's package, such as `packages/ui`, or `.` for the workspace root.

dependsOn.description: The tasks that must finish before this one starts, by ID: the task's own `dependsOn`, plus, with `-r`, `-t` or `--filter`, the same task in the packages this package depends on. A package without that task is skipped over. Each ID is a key of the same `plan` as this task. Absent when there are none.

steps.description: What the task runs, in order. Each part of the command between `&&`, each entry of a command array, and each `pre`/`post` script is one step. Each step is cached separately.

Step.description: A step of a task: a command, or a nested `vp run`.

program.description: The executable that would be started, as `vp run` finds it: a path relative to the workspace root if it is inside it, such as `apps/web/node_modules/.bin/vite`, otherwise an absolute path. A command with shell syntax, such as a pipe, runs through the shell: `/bin/sh` with `-c` and the command, or `cmd.exe` with `/d /s /c` on Windows. For a built-in such as `echo`, which runs without a new process, this is just its name.

args.description: The arguments, including any given after the task name. Absent when there are none.

cwd.description: The directory it runs in, when the task's `cwd` setting or an earlier `cd` in the command changes it. Absent when it runs in the package directory.

hook.description: The `pre` or `post` script the step comes from, such as `prebuild`. Absent for the task's own command.

cache.description:
Whether the cache would be used. Absent for a built-in such as `echo`.

The check looks at the files as they are now.

Cache.description: Whether a step would use the cache, and why it would run.

oneOf.description: Matches `baseline`, so it would replay `baseline` instead of running.
Differs from `baseline`, so it would run. `changes` lists the differences.
Would run: there is no cached run to compare with, as on a first run or after `vp cache clean`. Arguments given after the task name count, so a new combination of arguments is also `noBaseline`.
Would run: the cache couldn't be read. For example, the remote cache failed and nothing is cached locally.
Would run without caching, because caching is off for this step.

Baseline.description: The cached run a step is compared with.

durationMs.description: How long the cached run took, in milliseconds. On a hit, the time a replay saves.

Hit.description: A step that matches its cached run.

baseline.description: The cached run the step matches.

Change.description: One difference between a step and its cached run.

oneOf.description: The program changed. Each is the program as the cache records it: a path inside the workspace, or just the file name outside it, so `node` from another install is not a change.
The working directory changed. Each is relative to the workspace root.
The setting changed. A changed `input` is one change: the files it now matches aren't listed.
An env var was added, removed, or changed value.
A file was added, removed, or changed. `added` also covers a new file in a directory the task listed.

Setting.description: A task setting that affects caching.

HowChanged.description: How an env var or a file changed.

Changed.description: A step that differs from its cached run.

baseline.description: The cached run the step is compared with: the one with the same command, config and env, or, if there is none, the step's most recent cached run.

changes.description: Everything that differs from `baseline`, in the order the kinds are listed here, then by name or path. Undoing all of them would make the step a hit.

changesPartial.description: Other files may have changed too: without `-v`, the file check stops at the first changed file. Command, config and env changes are always listed in full. Without `-v`, the one file listed is the first changed file the check found, not necessarily the first by path. Absent with `-v`.

NestedStep.description: A nested `vp run`, which runs a plan of its own.

expandedFrom.description: The `vp run …` command this step stands for, as written, with any arguments given after the task name: `vp run -r test`.

plan.description: The plan of that nested `vp run`, in the same shape, so the plan is a tree. Its tasks start when this step does, after the task's earlier steps, and their `dependsOn` refers only to tasks in this nested plan: the same ID can appear in more than one plan. A nested run isn't started as a separate process, so the step has no `program`, `cwd` or `cache`.
